problem_statement: When GNRC IPv6 NIB processes a router advertisement prefix information option, a prefix whose SLAAC/A flag is set must be stored in the prefix list and subject to prefix lifetime management even if the on-link/L flag is not set. In the current behaviour, a PIO with the NDP_OPT_PI_FLAGS_A flag set but NDP_OPT_PI_FLAGS_L unset produces an autoconfigured address but no prefix list entry for the prefix. As a result, tests that expect the prefix to be found in the prefix list, and that check the prefix preferred lifetime, fail. The expected behaviour is that a PIO with the A flag set causes a prefix list entry to be created, just as a PIO with the L flag set does, regardless of whether the L flag is also present.
